newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt backs FY97 EPS consensus.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt backs FY97 EPS consensus.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Wednesday it is comfortable with the current consensus of analysts' earnings estimates for fiscal 1997 of about $2.80 a share, despite a pending deal to sell its Tastemaker joint venture.
"We are comfortable with the current consensus range," said Cole Lannum, director of investor relations.
The current consensus compares with restated earnings from continuing operations for fiscal 1996 of $2.26 a share, he added.
In an interview, Lannum declined to comment on 1998 earnings projections other than to say the company's long-term earnings per share growth goal remains 12 to 15 percent annually.
The earnings projection for 1997 did not change, analysts said, even though Mallinckrodt has agreed to sell its 50-50 venture, Tastemaker, a flavors joint venture with Hercules Inc.
Tastemaker is being sold to Roche Holding Ltd in a deal worth a combined $1.1 billion.

Analysts said Mallinckrodt's loss of earnings from Tastemaker will be offset by income from preferred stock of a Roche subsidiary that will be received in the deal, a reduction in interest expense and a stock repurchase that will reduce the number of shares outstanding.
Mallinckrodt is a chemical and pharmaceutical maker.
